description: Look up any transaction on Base by hash: whether it succeeded, reverted or is still pending, sender and receiver, ETH value, called method id, block number and time, number of confirmations, gas used, gas price and the execution fee paid, and whether it created a contract. Use to confirm that a payment or contract call went through before acting on it. Costs $0.003 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

hash.description: Transaction hash on Base: 0x followed by 64 hex characters

name: base-tx
